properties.case_summary_short: At age 9, Asha Jaquilla Degree disappeared from Shelby, North Carolina on February 14, 2000. Asha left her home during the early morning hours and was later seen walking along Highway 18 before disappearing. Her backpack was recovered over a year later, but she has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 8, Relisha Tenau Rudd disappeared from Washington D.C. on March 1, 2014. Relisha was last seen in Washington, D.C., while in the care of Kahlil Malik Tatum after her family had lived in a homeless shelter for more than a year. She has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 10, Tionda Z. Bradley disappeared from Chicago, Illinois on July 6, 2001. Tionda was last seen at her family's South Lake Park Avenue residence after her mother left for work around 6:30 a.m. She has not been seen since. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 3, Diamond Yvette Bradley disappeared from Chicago, Illinois on July 6, 2001. Diamond was last seen at her family's South Lake Park Avenue residence after her mother left for work around 6:30 a.m. She has not been seen since. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 2, Arianna Fitts disappeared from Oakland, California on February 1, 2016. Arianna disappeared as a toddler two months before her mother, Nicole Fitts, vanished after leaving work in San Francisco. Neither mother nor daughter has been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 2, Teekah Latres Lewis disappeared from Tacoma, Washington on January 23, 1999. Teekah was spending the evening at a Tacoma bowling alley with nearly a dozen relatives when she disappeared. She has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Stranger Abduction.

At age 2, Myra Rena Lewis disappeared from Camden, Mississippi on March 1, 2014. Myra was last seen playing outside her home before her mother left for the grocery store and told the children to go inside. She vanished during that period and remains missing. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 4, Rilya Shenise Wilson disappeared from Miami, Florida on January 18, 2001. Rilya had been placed with an alleged grandmother or godmother after being removed from her mother's custody. She later disappeared while in that woman's care, and the case is investigated as a suspected homicide. The disappearance is classified as Suspected Homicide.

At age 6, Adji Desir disappeared from Immokalee, Florida on January 10, 2009. Adji was left at his grandmother's home in Farm Workers Village while his mother went to work. He was last seen around 5:15 p.m. and has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 12, Jaliek L. Rainwalker disappeared from Greenwich, New York on November 1, 2007. Jaliek was last seen at his adoptive grandparents' home, where he spent the night alone with his adoptive father. He has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Missing Under Mysterious Circumstances.

At age 2, Christopher Milton Dansby disappeared from Manhattan, New York on May 18, 1989. Christopher disappeared from the Martin Luther King Jr. Towers playground in Harlem. He has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Stranger Abduction.

At age 1, Shane Anthony Walker disappeared from Manhattan, New York on August 10, 1989. Shane disappeared from the Martin Luther King Jr. Towers playground in Harlem while accompanied by his mother. He has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Stranger Abduction.

At age 7, Alexis S. Patterson disappeared from Milwaukee, Wisconsin on May 3, 2002. Her stepfather said he walked her to Hi-Mount Boulevard School around 8:00 a.m. She was not seen again. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 5, Hassani Jamil Campbell disappeared from Oakland, California on August 10, 2009. Hassani was reportedly last seen in Oakland's Rockridge district around 4:15 p.m. No confirmed trace of him has been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 24, Unique RaQuel-Leona Harris disappeared from Washington D.C. on October 9, 2010. Unique was last seen at the Washington, D.C., apartment she shared with her two young sons only five weeks after moving in. She is presumed deceased but has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Suspected Homicide.

At age 22, Akia Shawnta Eggleston disappeared from Baltimore, Maryland on May 3, 2017. Akia withdrew more than $500 from a Baltimore bank shortly before she vanished, an amount considered unusual for her. She is presumed deceased but has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Suspected Homicide.

At age 23, Phoenix Lucille Coldon disappeared from Spanish Lake, Missouri on December 18, 2011. Phoenix was sitting in her car in the driveway before her father watched her drive away around 2:20 p.m. She has never been seen again. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 4, Jaquilla Evonne Scales disappeared from Wichita, Kansas on September 5, 2001. Jaquilla was seen asleep in her bed around 12:30 a.m. and discovered missing approximately two and a half hours later. She has never been seen again. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 23, Laresha Deana Walker disappeared from Nashville, Tennessee on November 19, 1999. Laresha dropped her two-year-old son off at her sister's Nashville home for the night. She disappeared afterward and has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 47, Pamela J. Butler disappeared from Washington D.C. on February 12, 2009. Pamela was last seen speaking with her boyfriend, Jose Angel Rodriguez-Cruz, at her Washington, D.C., home around 9:48 p.m. She has never been found. The disappearance is classified as Suspected Homicide.

At age 26, Kierra Michelle Coles disappeared from Chicago, Illinois on October 2, 2018. Kierra never arrived at the post office where she worked after calling in sick that day. She has not been heard from again. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 15, Jeannette Latrice Millbrook disappeared from Augusta, Georgia on March 18, 1990. Jeannette was last seen with her twin sister at a Pump-N-Shop gas station in Augusta. Neither sister has ever been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 15, Dannette Latonia Millbrook disappeared from Augusta, Georgia on March 18, 1990. Dannette was last seen with her twin sister at a Pump-N-Shop gas station in Augusta. Neither sister has ever been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 19, Logan Drew Schiendelman disappeared from Tumwater, Washington on May 19, 2016. Logan was last seen in Tumwater and has never been heard from again. No confirmed trace of him has been found. The disappearance is classified as Endangered Missing.

At age 33, Anthony Tyrone Lee disappeared from Longview, Texas on June 25, 2011. Anthony disappeared from his Longview residence, which appeared to have been left suddenly.
